name: Wall of Sorrowful Shadows
body:
School illusion (shadow) [darkness, fear, mind-affecting]; Level cleric/oracle 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a bit of black wool)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect A straight wall with an area of up to one 10 ft. square per level (S)
Duration 10 minutes/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

When you cast this spell you summon a curtain of writhing shadow that quickly settles into a disquieting stillness. The wall is pitch black and blocks light passing through in either direction.

Creatures cannot see through the wall unless they possess some way of seeing through magical darkness. Any creature that passes through the wall must make a Will save or be shaken with images of their own failures and shortcomings for 1d6 rounds. Otherwise the wall does not hinder movement in any way.

The wall need not be vertical or supported by any existing structure when it is created, but each section of the wall does need to be contiguous.
